checks: Opening the main Spotlight input checks capability without loading a model or creating a worker
Explicit model load shows progress and cancellation terminates its worker
A failed load can be retried and an empty message cannot be sent
Math in the main input uses the exact calculator instead of the LLM
Filename queries enable workspace search and open files without invoking the model
Oversized Unicode prompts stay editable when the model context limit rejects them
Enter streams a response while keeping prompts out of persistent storage and network requests
Follow-up messages include the current conversation context
Switching to math and application search keeps an active reply running
Stop response interrupts generation and returns keyboard focus to the input
New chat clears conversation text without persisting it
Generation failures are visible and Retry response resends the same prompt successfully
Website-like text goes to the local model and does not navigate or search the web
Closing Spotlight stops generation before reopening the conversation
Unload model releases its worker and GPU resources
Remove download requests cache deletion and returns to the opt-in state
The integrated Spotlight fits a narrow viewport and scrolls to model controls and keyboard help
Unsupported browsers receive an explanation while normal Spotlight calculations still work
An unavailable workspace lookup reaches its deadline and allows ordinary text to reach the model
Enter opens the selected matching file while other workspace folders are still pending
